info.title: Power Assist Universal API
info.description: Power Assist provides utility and data-manipulation actions for arrays, strings, math, type checks, and validation through Elevate Digital's RapidAPI-backed API.

get.description: Calculates an average with Power Assist.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: numbers[]
parameters.description: Array of numbers to average. Numeric strings are allowed when they do not contain formatting such as commas.
